`Map.groupBy` is implemented in `crates/kahvi-builtins/src/map/group_by.rs`, the only file changed. `./t262 built-ins/Map/groupBy/` gives 20 of 28 runs passing, up from 4 files on main. The other 8 runs fail with "not implemented: Map.prototype.keys", a stub owned by another ticket, so they are not counted against this one. `cargo build` and `cargo clippy -p kahvi-builtins` are clean.

The implementation covers only the `~collection~` key path, which is all `Map.groupBy` needs. Groups are stored as entries of the result Map, so the GC keeps them alive during callbacks.
